snippets.en: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
snippets.tr: É esta a terceira vez que vou ter convosco. Pela boca de duas ou três testemunhas será confirmada toda palavra.

snippets.en: Paul declares that “in the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established” ([2 Corinthians 13:1](https://www.churchofjesuschrist.org/study/scriptures/nt/2-cor/13?lang=eng&id=p1#p1)).
snippets.tr: Paulo declara que “por boca de duas ou três testemunhas será confirmada toda a palavra” (II Coríntios 13:1).

snippets.en: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.
snippets.tr: Por boca de dos testigos o de tres testigos morirá el que haya de morir; no morirá por boca de un solo testigo.
